summary: Examples of the env lookup: reading HOME, setting a default before 2.13 with the default filter, using the default parameter, and failing with default=undef().
questions: How do I default an environment variable to World if unset?
How do I make the env lookup fail when a variable is missing?

answer_card.title: env lookup examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "'{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.env', 'HOME') }}' is HOME"

# before 2.13
- ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "Hello {{ lookup('ansible.builtin.env', 'UNDEFINED_VARIABLE') | default('World', True) }}"

# 2.13+
- ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "Hello {{ lookup('ansible.builtin.env', 'UNDEFINED_VARIABLE', default='World') }}"

# fail if not defined
- ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "Hello {{ lookup('ansible.builtin.env', 'UNDEFINED_VARIABLE', default=undef()) }}"
```
